estimates.assumptions: 14 oz jar ≈ 400 g total weight; typical red enchilada sauce values ~10 g carbs/100 g and ~2 g fiber/100 g; entire jar used.
3 US cups shredded Monterey Jack ≈ 340 g; cheese has minimal lactose carbs (~3.5 g/100 g) and negligible fiber; entire amount used.
6 standard 6-inch corn tortillas ≈ 240 g total (≈40 g each); typical values ~50 g carbs/100 g and ~7.5 g fiber/100 g; all 6 used.
2 raw boneless skinless chicken breasts ≈ 400 g total; plain chicken has no carbohydrates or fiber; all meat used.
